_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score remains inside Denial band with only 3% of recent 12h windows moving ±2pts, NFP still 71h out, and no proven library trigger, so the skilled call is continued coil/HOLD until a real flush or reclaim.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial and non-aggressive stance; narrative supplies no independent forward direction so analyst HOLD is the consensus default
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score stays inside 32-38, BTC holds recent range, funding non-negative, and no macro print forces a break
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative with long/short percentile collapse (down to Panic) or ETF flows turn positive with Fear & Greed back above 40 (up to Anxiety)
